findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 3, Harm 2
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - a cold reader reports a missing promised check with Gain 3, Work 3, Harm 2.
This line says `Not done` holds at any score, but `src/forge/score.py:137–142` evaluates cold-read notes solely through the score bar. Those scores do not hold; `score.py:75` automatically records a keep disposition, and `src/forge/story.py:721` allows the read to pass. Unlike reviews, cold reads have no `required_done_when` override. Consequently, item 2's promised-check exception is unmet. Make the cold-read instructions or handling ensure these notes actually block, and cover this case through `forge read`; the added test currently returns no cold-read findings.
